milestone: Phase 2A — Feature Engineering and Baseline Feasibility

target_discharge_24h_cumecs.name: target_discharge_24h_cumecs
target_discharge_24h_cumecs.source: Haryana I&WRD Hathnikund Barrage Downstream Release (HKB D/S)
target_discharge_24h_cumecs.availability_time: Time t + 24h (08:00 IST of date + 1 day)
target_discharge_24h_cumecs.missing_value_behavior: Null (NaN) if date + 1 day is missing in source; excluded from supervised training
target_discharge_24h_cumecs.leakage_risk: TARGET VARIABLE: Strictly excluded from all predictor matrices

discharge_current_cumecs.name: discharge_current_cumecs
discharge_current_cumecs.source: Haryana I&WRD Hathnikund Barrage Downstream Release (HKB D/S)
discharge_current_cumecs.availability_time: Available at forecast issue time t (08:00 IST morning gauge)
discharge_current_cumecs.missing_value_behavior: If missing, forecast cannot be issued

discharge_lag_1d_cumecs.name: discharge_lag_1d_cumecs
discharge_lag_1d_cumecs.source: Haryana I&WRD Hathnikund Barrage Downstream Release (HKB D/S)
discharge_lag_1d_cumecs.availability_time: Known 24 hours prior to forecast issue time t
discharge_lag_1d_cumecs.missing_value_behavior: Null if date - 1 day was unobserved; no silent zero-filling

discharge_lag_2d_cumecs.name: discharge_lag_2d_cumecs
discharge_lag_2d_cumecs.source: Haryana I&WRD Hathnikund Barrage Downstream Release (HKB D/S)
discharge_lag_2d_cumecs.availability_time: Known 48 hours prior to forecast issue time t
discharge_lag_2d_cumecs.missing_value_behavior: Null if date - 2 days was unobserved

discharge_lag_3d_cumecs.name: discharge_lag_3d_cumecs
discharge_lag_3d_cumecs.source: Haryana I&WRD Hathnikund Barrage Downstream Release (HKB D/S)
discharge_lag_3d_cumecs.availability_time: Known 72 hours prior to forecast issue time t
discharge_lag_3d_cumecs.missing_value_behavior: Null if date - 3 days was unobserved

discharge_lag_7d_cumecs.name: discharge_lag_7d_cumecs
discharge_lag_7d_cumecs.source: Haryana I&WRD Hathnikund Barrage Downstream Release (HKB D/S)
discharge_lag_7d_cumecs.availability_time: Known 7 days prior to forecast issue time t
discharge_lag_7d_cumecs.missing_value_behavior: Null if date - 7 days was unobserved

discharge_rolling_mean_3d_cumecs.name: discharge_rolling_mean_3d_cumecs
discharge_rolling_mean_3d_cumecs.missing_value_behavior: Null if any of the 3 days is missing

discharge_rolling_mean_7d_cumecs.name: discharge_rolling_mean_7d_cumecs
discharge_rolling_mean_7d_cumecs.missing_value_behavior: Null if any of the 7 days is missing

discharge_rolling_max_7d_cumecs.name: discharge_rolling_max_7d_cumecs
discharge_rolling_max_7d_cumecs.missing_value_behavior: Null if any of the 7 days is missing

discharge_rolling_std_7d_cumecs.name: discharge_rolling_std_7d_cumecs
discharge_rolling_std_7d_cumecs.missing_value_behavior: Null if any of the 7 days is missing

inflow_current_cumecs.name: inflow_current_cumecs
inflow_current_cumecs.source: Haryana I&WRD Hathnikund Barrage Upstream Inflow (HKB U/S)
inflow_current_cumecs.availability_time: Available at forecast issue time t (08:00 IST morning gauge)
inflow_current_cumecs.missing_value_behavior: Null if unobserved (7 dry season dates missing in HKB U/S)

inflow_release_ratio_current.name: inflow_release_ratio_current
inflow_release_ratio_current.source: Derived from HKB U/S and HKB D/S
inflow_release_ratio_current.missing_value_behavior: Null if HKB U/S is missing
inflow_release_ratio_current.leakage_risk: None: Captures canal diversion regime at time t

rainfall_mean_d_minus_1_mm.name: rainfall_mean_d_minus_1_mm
rainfall_mean_d_minus_1_mm.source: IMD Pune 0.25° Gridded Regional Summary (91 cells)
rainfall_mean_d_minus_1_mm.lookback_window: Preceding 24h accumulation ending at 08:30 IST on date - 1
rainfall_mean_d_minus_1_mm.availability_time: Known prior to forecast issue time t (ended ~23.5h prior)
rainfall_mean_d_minus_1_mm.missing_value_behavior: Null if gridded record absent (0 missing in 2018-2024)
rainfall_mean_d_minus_1_mm.leakage_risk: None: Strictly antecedent (ended prior to current morning)

rainfall_max_cell_d_minus_1_mm.name: rainfall_max_cell_d_minus_1_mm
rainfall_max_cell_d_minus_1_mm.lookback_window: Preceding 24h peak single-cell rainfall on date - 1
rainfall_max_cell_d_minus_1_mm.availability_time: Known prior to forecast issue time t

rainfall_accum_3d_prior_mm.name: rainfall_accum_3d_prior_mm
rainfall_accum_3d_prior_mm.availability_time: Known prior to forecast issue time t
rainfall_accum_3d_prior_mm.missing_value_behavior: Null if any constituent day is missing

rainfall_accum_7d_prior_mm.name: rainfall_accum_7d_prior_mm
rainfall_accum_7d_prior_mm.availability_time: Known prior to forecast issue time t
rainfall_accum_7d_prior_mm.missing_value_behavior: Null if any constituent day is missing

rainfall_max_cell_3d_prior_mm.name: rainfall_max_cell_3d_prior_mm
rainfall_max_cell_3d_prior_mm.availability_time: Known prior to forecast issue time t
rainfall_max_cell_3d_prior_mm.missing_value_behavior: Null if any constituent day is missing

rainfall_mean_same_day_retro_mm.name: rainfall_mean_same_day_retro_mm
rainfall_mean_same_day_retro_mm.lookback_window: Accumulation ending at 08:30 IST on date t
rainfall_mean_same_day_retro_mm.availability_time: RETROSPECTIVE ARCHIVE ONLY: IMD gridded products have 24-48h publication latency
rainfall_mean_same_day_retro_mm.leakage_risk: OPERATIONAL LEAKAGE RISK: Not available in real-time operational forecasting. Strictly research/retrospective only.
